curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why originals are required, then sort identity items into the Primary and Secondary lists.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on document originals, the two identity lists and refused documents.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on which identity documents are accepted or refused.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show who must prove citizenship or permanent residency, and what applicants with temporary legal presence can receive.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on who must prove status, accepted proofs and temporary licenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on citizenship proof and temporary licenses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the two residency proofs and the Social Security number rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on accepted and refused residency proofs and Social Security rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on residency documents and Social Security proof.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the extra papers for applicants under eighteen, then the name change document rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on teen forms, GDL scope and name change papers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on teen paperwork and name change documents.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate the newcomer deadline from the testing trigger, then cover the active-duty extension.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on newcomer deadlines, testing and military license rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on new residents and service members.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through license terms, fees, renewal and what happens after expiration.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on license terms, fees, late renewal and the lack of a grace period.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on fees, renewal timing and expiration.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover address change reporting, legal addresses and driver record privacy.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the address deadline, address format and record privacy.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on address changes and record privacy.
